templates.getTemplatesByIdInputSchema.description: Returns the JSON Schema that `input` must satisfy in `POST /passes` for this template's active version. Field labels, groups and order are in the `x-label`, `x-group` and `x-order` keywords. Use it to build a form or generate types.

templates.getTemplatesByIdRollout.description: How far the approved release has reached the organization's passes in the request's mode. `remaining` counts active passes on a different, non-equivalent build, the ones the automatic rollout moves, and `updating` splits the ones still on their way by version. Passes left behind are counted in `failedCount`: the rebuild recorded why, or every rebuild of this release has finished (or none started within ten minutes, `stalled`). `failed` lists the first 50 with the reason, only for a caller who can also read passes. `tell` offers a message to the holders whose passes are on the release, for 24 hours after it and until one is sent; send it as a message broadcast targeting `{ templateIds, version }` with `tell.key` as the `Idempotency-Key`.

templates.getTemplatesByIdSampleCsv.description: Downloads a sample import file for the template: one column per field, labeled as in the pass form, and Holder email, with one valid row. Importing it with mapping auto maps every column and checks without errors.

templates.postTemplatesByIdRelease.description: Release a saved version to Test and Live in one call. Test runs first, then Live; each mode creates or reuses its candidate, reuses or writes an approval (a `test` approval in Test, a `sole` approval in Live only for the sole reviewer) and publishes at the expected generation. Test follows Live: a newer Test head stays and is reported as `kept`. Another reviewer's approval is needed otherwise: 409 `TEMPLATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED` with the plan; Test stays released and a repeat call resumes. `?dryRun=true` returns the plan and changes nothing. Send `Idempotency-Key`: the same key and body replays the stored answer with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. `expected` is the generation each head must still be at, `0` before a first release. A Test key may name only `test`; a Live key cannot release.

templates.postTemplatesByIdReviewRequest.description: Create or reuse the Test and Live candidates of a saved version without approving them, and email the org's other reviewers. A newer request replaces an older open one. Send `Idempotency-Key`.

templates.postTemplatesByIdReview.description: Approve a requested version in Test and Live as a peer. A Test key approves Test only. Set `release` to also release it when you can publish. You cannot approve your own work.
